epitaphs.epitaph: She walked into the grey and never came back the same.
He held the line so others could retreat.
The ration line ended before her turn came.
Sleep finally took her, and did not return her.
The pathogen came from somewhere; the names are forgotten.
He walked out of the holdfast and did not walk back.
The blast finished what the war began.
The catalogue of the dead keeps its own ledger.
